articles.title: Syrian chemical weapons use, a fraudulent casus belli to justify Western intervention?
articles.summary: Capitalized 'United States' (was 'United states'), split a long run-on opening sentence with a full stop, and turned three pasted Blogger/Markdown link fragments into working Markdown links for the three cited sources (CNN, RT, Stratfor). Second-pass QA removed four unrelated CNN headline snippets embedded in the quoted passage, changed 'will' to 'would' for agreement, and corrected Western, Alawite-led and Mediterranean Sea casing and compounds. All claims, the political spin, image URLs and dates preserved unchanged.

articles.title: German colonisation of Europe
articles.summary: Corrected 'Fresians' to 'Frisians', 'often' from 'oft' in a likely contraction typo, 'World War II' from lowercase 'world war II', and 'France' capitalised mid-sentence. Fixed the duplicated word 'the the' (to 'to the') and the misused 'reigns' to 'reins'. Wrapped the Thatcher and Mitterrand quotes as blockquotes, and turned the broken Telegraph citation link into a clean Markdown link. Second-pass QA corrected Western Roman Empire and Roman Empire casing, 'intermittent' to 'intervening', a comma splice, compound hyphenation, introductory punctuation and the vocative comma in 'Nice try, France'. Image URL, Wikipedia link and URL preserved unchanged.

articles.title: Google glasses and our future as Borg
articles.summary: Corrected obvious typos: 'show casing' to 'showcasing', 'wont' to 'won't', 'Borge' to 'Borg', 'matrix' to 'Matrix' (the film) in the parallel construction, and 'Seven of Nine' from 'seven of nine'. Replaced the standalone 'prediction number 6!' hanging fragment with a tighter intro sentence. Second-pass QA capitalised Earth in both references. All image URLs, dates, jokes and the closing 'Resistance is futile!' preserved.

articles.title: Syrian crisis - hegemony via chaos

Second-pass QA capitalised Western, hyphenated 'mini-states' and supplied the missing 'that' and punctuation around the Iraq aside. Map image URL, URL, labels and Chomsky quote preserved verbatim.

articles.title: Will technology empower the individual or lead to our demise?
articles.summary: Repaired a mangled book-title Markdown link ('Dialectic of Enlightenment *...p.125') and two stray Wikipedia links that were inline with text. Rejoined an accidentally line-broken sentence in the Kelly paragraph. Fixed 'provents' to 'prevent', inserted 'a' before 'clear understanding', fixed the inline 'Cody Wilson' quote to a blockquote, and wrapped the Kelly and Waking Life quotes as blockquotes. Wired-up the Foreign Policy Cody Wilson article into a single Markdown link. Second-pass QA fixed 'civilisation-sized', punctuation after 'On the one hand', 'Here are a couple', the missing 'of' after 'understanding', and Earth and Telescopic Evolution casing. All factual claims, the Kelly quotes and image URL preserved unchanged.

articles.title: Ukrainian protests - Russia vs West
articles.summary: Capitalised 'European Union' consistently (was 'European union' in places), fixed the apostrophe-in-numbered-list ('2)' '2.'), corrected 'Austrio-Hungarian' to 'Austro-Hungarian', dropped an extraneous 'the' before 'Ukraine' where the country was used directly, and changed the colon/comma structure on the opening sentence to make the choice readable. Second-pass QA hyphenated 'Russian-led', standardised 'substates', and restored the source's closing exclamation mark. Crimea facts, image URL, dates and labels preserved.

articles.title: Crimea, Ukraine and the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth

Second-pass QA repaired the comma splice between the Ukrainian-speaking and Russian-speaking regions and supplied the missing article in 'Yanukovych, the pro-Russian president'. All image URLs and the historical claims preserved unchanged.
